start: ^I was on the crucifixion detail. Three men. Three crosses. A hill outside the city. The air thick with dust and death. I have executed men before. Many men. But this one... this one was different. From the moment He arrived, He was different. He didn't curse. He didn't struggle. He carried His own cross. Until He couldn't. Then a Cyrenian carried it for Him.

c-0: ^They nailed Him to the cross. Between two thieves. He didn't cry out. Not until the ninth hour. Then He shouted: 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?' Psalm 22. David's psalm. Written a thousand years before. And every detail was being fulfilled. The piercing. The casting of lots. The mocking. The unbroken bones. All of it. Right in front of me.
c-1: ^Different? He was different from the moment I saw Him. No fear. No anger. No desperation. Just... peace. A peace that passed all understanding. While we hammered the nails. While the crowd mocked. While the thieves cursed. He prayed. For them. For us. For the world. That is not a criminal. That is a king. A different kind of king.
